deploy-bot: Build started for image redwood/inference:release-2026-03-20-staging (commit abc1234) — environment: staging — CI #4521
alice.chen: ack, watching.
deploy-bot: Build finished: image built, pushing to registry ghcr.io/redwood-inference/staging:release-2026-03-20
infra-ci: pushing layers -> started

deploy-bot: pushing manifest -> started

deploy-bot: ERROR: registry responded 504 Gateway Timeout while uploading blob sha256:0f4a... (attempt 1/3)
sam.k: can we retry automatically? that's the mirror node, flapping.
deploy-bot: retrying push (attempt 2/3)
maria_ops: FYI change window ends in 40m; prefer no escalation unless rollout fails.

deploy-bot: attempt 2 -> uploaded layer sha256:0f4a... OK, now uploading manifest

deploy-bot: WARNING: manifest upload returned 409 Conflict for tag "staging-release" -> existing digest detected

deploy-bot: Detected digest mismatch: existing=sha256:aaaa1111 computed=sha256:bbbb2222
alice.chen: hold on pin decision — do we want to force-overwrite tag? that would affect consumers.
sam.k: prefer to pin to computed digest sha256:bbbb2222 and avoid retagging.
maria_ops: agreed. pin it and add a release note. prepare rollback plan if consumers fail.

alice.chen: can we run a canary with the pinned image? one pod first.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started -> 1/10 pods -> image pinned to sha256:bbbb2222

deploy-bot: Push status: complete; tag was not moved. Image available by digest only.
infra-ci: metadata updated: pin.reason=manual_digest_mismatch; pinned_by=alice.chen; commit=abc1234
sam.k: adding note to release doc: "staging push pinned due to digest mismatch; manual verification required before promoting to prod"
alice.chen: running quick smoke tests now.

deploy-bot: Smoke tests: 2/2 checks passed (endpoint /health, sample generation). Latency within expected.
maria_ops: :thumbsup: proceed when ready. open a follow-up thread for prod promotion.
alice.chen: created INC-4521 and added release note https://gojira/release/4521

deploy-bot: Thread closed: push completed with pin. CI logs: https://ci/logs/4521
sam.k: thanks everyone, resolving.
